notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Thraben Doomsayer's ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing the Human, untapping Necrotic Ooze and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
